subject: Request for executive pricing variance — Synapse Labs (hosted API >20% discount)
messages:

To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>

Can Redwood provide a 30% off list for the first 6 months + a usage-based ramp credit? Procurement would like this in writing before we move to signatures.

Regards,

Alex — thanks, and great to see the forward momentum.

Quick clarifying items:
- Confirming the 40M tokens/mo is baseline for months 4-6, with a pilot at ~5M tokens/mo across months 1-3.
- You asked specifically for 30% off list for 6 months + ramp credits; that exceeds standard commercial tolerances for Hosted API (approval typically required for >20% off).

I looped in Ben and Marissa from deal desk to prepare a brief for exec approval. If leadership approves, we can formalize a timebound concession (start/end dates, minimum commitment, and fallback to standard rates thereafter).

Would you be able to confirm the expected start date and whether the pilot will include EU traffic (affects routing and committed region)?

Thanks — Avery

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exec approval request for Synapse concession (draft)

Marissa / Steph —

Drafting this for exec review. Synapse Labs is asking for 30% off Hosted API for 6 months + ramp credits tied to usage milestones. Highlights for the memo:
- Account: Synapse Labs (AI platform; multi-region roadmap)
- Ask: 30% off list for 6 months (months 1-6), usage credits for months 3-6 if 30M+ tokens/mo achieved
- Commitments offered: 12-month contract, 40M tokens/mo target by month 4, reference case + co-marketing (conditional)
- Financial impact: estimated 26% unit margin reduction in Q4; payback depends on renewals at standard rates after month 6
- Risks: precedent for >20% for similar-sized strategic accounts; mitigations: timebound, indexed to usage, and auto-revert to standard pricing at month 7

Proposed recommendation: approve up to 30% for first 3 months, then re-evaluate months 4-6 based on verified usage telemetry. If leadership wants to commit full 30% for six months, need senior signoff (CEO/CRO).

Marissa — can you turn this into a one-page exec request? Can we get signoff by EOD Thu? Synapse wants a written concession to proceed to signatures.

Quoted message below.

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: CEO <ceo@redwood.ai>, CRO <cro@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Synapse Labs Hosted API concession (>20%) — decision requested

Team —

Summary: Synapse Labs (RDW-2478-SYN) requests a 30% discount off list for Hosted API for the first 6 months of a 12-month contract, plus ramp credits contingent on reaching 30M tokens/mo by month 4. The account will likely deliver multi-region adoption (US primary, EU potential). They are strategic for platform integration and have strong reference potential.

Commercial details:
- List price baseline: $0.0008/token (example)
- Proposed concession: 30% off list months 1-6; months 7-12 revert to list rates
- Commitments: 12-month term, minimum usage clause (20M tokens/mo averaged across months 4-6)
- Attachments: Synapse_SOW_v1.pdf, usage_forecast_q4_q1.xlsx

Recommendation (Deal Desk): Approve temporary concession with the following guardrails:
1) Approve up to 30% for months 1-3; continuation to months 4-6 contingent on verified telemetry and an explicit renewal negotiation window at month 5.
2) Require a minimum average usage clause to avoid revenue loss (20M tokens/mo floor).
3) Include auto-revert clause and a 60-day notice prior to any rate changes.
4) Marketing/reference commitment in writing, with opt-out if contract not renewed.

Decision requested: Approve the recommended staged concession (30% for months 1-3; conditional extension to months 4-6) or instruct alternate percentage/terms.

If approved, Ben will send a formal concession letter to Synapse and Legal will finalize the SOW. DocuSign link pending.

Thanks — please reply with APPROVE / REJECT / MODIFY and any comments.

Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

Ben — you have clearance to finalize the concession letter and route the SOW to DocuSign. Keep me copied on the signature once live.
